_doc: Real-print lyric OCR gold, hand-transcribed from the local page corpus (image paths under gitignored data/, so scoring requires the local corpus). page_0498: four syllabic 'Κυριε ελεησον' Greek lyric rows, each opening with an ornamental drop-cap Kappa. page_0487 (bilingual): the red Arabic subtitle (clean running Arabic), two syllabic Arabic lyric rows, and two syllabic Greek lyric rows. Conventions: text is the printed glyphs in visual left-to-right order (both scripts' syllables are laid out under the L->R neumes); Arabic is transcribed as BASE LETTERS WITHOUT harakat (the import-relevant signal), so harakat the engine emits counts against it. Syllabic rows with large inter-syllable gaps need TesseractBackend's --psm 7 -> --psm 6 fallback. Score: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH uv run python tools/audit_lyric_ocr.py score --gold config/expected_lyrics_real.json --output data/lyric_ocr_report_real.json
